## Since v0.51.6

`v0.51.6` was published from `ea183465` (the #333 merge). Since then
`origin/main` gained:

- #334: the expected pre-seal ruleset probe failure is quiet in the apply log.
- #335: QA checks behavior against quoted product policies and project rules
  (`policy_mismatch`) and measures inefficiency (`inefficiency`); `/auto qa`
  runs user scenarios (`auto qa intent` -> `auto qa go --no-loop` ->
  `auto qa exec --all`) before the hunt; intent questions carry per-option
  `details`; the Stop-hook verification round is on by default and picks
  light/full from changed product code lines.
- #336: a session whose light round came early is escalated once to the full
  round when its change grows by another 40 product code lines or gains a
  product file. The 40-line line was checked against 600 recent merged PRs.

#335 changes the generated surface (`qa-hunt`, `qa-explorer`, `auto-qa`,
`autonomy`, and the shared Autonomy section of `AGENTS.md`). If the Upgrade
Canary pins any of those for the *new* side, expect to teach it after
publication; its previous-side expectations stay at v0.51.6.

Neither change touches `go.mod`, `go.sum`, or
`scripts/companion-release/canaryhelper/`, so the canary helper installed on
2026-11-13 still matches; `prepare-release.sh` verifies the hash anyway.

## Coordinate move notes (A47 = v0.51.6 -> A48 = v0.51.7)

The move was scripted:

```bash
scripts/release-tools/measure-published-release.sh v0.51.6 \
  --predecessor-commit 8ab8b182c425ab8a68112293e8ab272ff3765dcb >measurement.json
scripts/release-tools/advance-release-coordinate.sh v0.51.6 A47 v0.51.7 A48 \
  --measurements measurement.json
```

`measure-published-release.sh` read `v0.51.6` without writing anything, and
`advance-release-coordinate.sh` applied every file listed in
`advance-release-coordinate-rules.pl`: the A47 declaration (eleven pins)
and the A48 branch in `verify-public-key-lineage-coordinates.sh`, the
`v0.51.7) release_phase='A48'` row, `A48_A47_ANCESTOR_SHA` (`ea183465fa5955c683cca89f9b5e2bd5e2c8ed09`)
and its ancestor arm in `validate-source.sh`, `A48` in every accumulating phase
list and frozen-policy message, the receipt row, the shipped phase table and
lineage matrix rows, the upgrade canary predecessor (`live 0.51.6 0.51.7`),
the preflight predecessor default, the Homebrew `PRIOR_TAP_COMMIT` /
`PRIOR_CASK_BLOB` pins (`98a963dc` / `d592e4ee`), and every test that pins the
current coordinate. History lines (the A47 rows, burn records, incident
comments) are kept by explicit rules and did not move.

This move is based on `6a66f961`.

directory; they hash to the API digests, and the four archives hash to their
`checksums.txt` entries. The manifests are measured inside the darwin archives
(`adk-companion-manifest.json`), and each manifest's `artifact_digest` is the
`auto` binary beside it (amd64 `18f47684`, arm64 `3c9a764e`); both manifests
say version `0.51.6` and build provenance `ea183465fa59`. The tag header names
exactly `ea183465fa59`, `commit`, and `v0.51.6`, and the tag's SSH signature
verifies against the R2 trust root. The A46 source `8ab8b182` is an ancestor
of `ea183465fa59`, and `ea183465fa59` is an ancestor of `main`. The tap head's parent is
the previous `PRIOR_TAP_COMMIT` (`80f72b6d`), so the pin chain continues, the
Formula blob is frozen, and the Cask carries the four archive digests.

## Before `--apply`

| Item | Expected state |
|---|---|
| Ruleset `autopus-v0.51.7-release-authority` | **missing** until armed below |
| Deployment tag policy `v0.51.7` on `adk-companion-release` | **missing** until armed below |
| `v0.51.7` and `omp-context-evidence-v0.51.7` | absent on origin, and so is `omp-context-evidence-v0.51.7-source` |
| Draft release named `v0.51.7` | absent; Latest is `443543192` (`v0.51.6`) |

`verify-release-tag-ruleset.sh --armed` fails until both authorities exist.
Create them in the exact shape it accepts, then verify. Prep seals the ruleset
right after the tag exists. Never widen an older ruleset to cover the new tag.

```bash
gh api -X POST repos/autopus-ai/autopus-adk/rulesets --input - <<'JSON'
{"name":"autopus-v0.51.7-release-authority","target":"tag","enforcement":"active",
 "bypass_actors":[{"actor_id":204883817,"actor_type":"User","bypass_mode":"always"}],
 "conditions":{"ref_name":{"include":["refs/tags/v0.51.7"],"exclude":[]}},
 "rules":[{"type":"creation"},{"type":"update"},{"type":"deletion"}]}
JSON
gh api -X POST repos/autopus-ai/autopus-adk/environments/adk-companion-release/deployment-branch-policies \
  -f name=v0.51.7 -f type=tag
scripts/companion-release/verify-release-tag-ruleset.sh --armed
```

A48 needs fresh evidence. Never reuse any earlier report, attestation,
evidence commit, evidence tag object, draft, or workflow artifact. If
`scripts/release-tools/install-canary-helper.sh` changed since the helper was
installed, reinstall it in a real terminal before `--apply`.

```bash
export OMP_AUTH_BROKER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47311
export ADK_GATEWAY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47312
export ADK_RELEASE_MODEL=gpt-6.1-sol
export ADK_RELEASE_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOW=262144
scripts/release-tools/release-prep.sh --preflight
scripts/release-tools/release-prep.sh --apply
```

## Stop conditions

- `--apply` exit 75 leaves the prep lock retained on purpose. Inspect the
  remote state, fix only what is outside the source, and retry `--apply` on
  the identical source; never delete the lock or the evidence tag by hand.
- If the tap head moves off `98a963dc` before publication, re-measure
  (`measure-published-release.sh v0.51.6`) and move the PRIOR pins first.
- The tag is immutable once pushed. If anything mismatches after that, do not
  move, delete, or reuse `v0.51.7`; carry the coordinate to `v0.51.8` and
  record the burn here.
- After publication, run the Upgrade Canary by hand
  (`gh workflow run upgrade-canary.yaml --ref v0.51.7`). A failure on the
  *previous* surface expectations is a canary fix, not a release fault.
